investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Caldix Freight (freight and logistics); Platform: AWS ap-southeast-1 (zones ap-southeast-1a/ap-southeast-1b/ap-southeast-1c); network range 10.43.0.0/16; Database: postgres server booking-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-e7ed4eeaa00ce5f08; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
